Description: Deliver core catalog and shopping workflows.
As a customer, I want to browse and search active products so that I can find items to buy.
Acceptance Criteria: Given active products exist; when I open the catalog; then only active products are returned with name and price.

Description: As a customer, I want to add, update, and remove cart items so that I can manage a purchase.
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am authenticated; when I change my cart; then the change is scoped to my account and invalid quantities are rejected.

Description: As a customer, I want checkout to persist an order and its items atomically so that my order history is accurate.
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid shipping and payment selection; when checkout succeeds; then server-calculated totals and order items are committed together; on failure no partial order remains.

Description: Improve deployability, reliability, and support readiness.

Summary: Add Redis catalog cache and invalidation
Description: Implement cache-aside with TTL and invalidate cached catalog views after writes.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a warmed cache; when a product or category changes; then subsequent affected catalog reads reflect the committed change; Redis errors are logged and reads fall back to SQL.

Summary: Publish and verify signed Redis events
Description: Publish product lifecycle events with HMAC signatures and consume only verified events.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid signing secret; when a product event is published; then publish and consume logs include its event ID; altered or malformed envelopes are rejected.

Description: Build a Compose stack with Nginx proxy and CI checks.
Acceptance Criteria: Given configured local environment values; when Compose starts; then API health is available through Nginx and persistent data volumes survive container recreation.

Description: As a release owner, I want a repeatable smoke-test and rollback checklist so that I can deploy safely.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a candidate release; when release checks pass; then health, catalog, authenticated route, and upload smoke tests are recorded before approval.
